text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the north side of Roselawn Avenue, between Avenue Road and Oriole Parkway

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space in effect at all times on the north side of Roselawn Avenue, between a point 53.2 metres west of Oriole Parkway and a point 5.5 metres further west.
